brand_dna.category: Queer and nerdy apparel, pins, patches, resin art and Judaica - identity-forward merch made by and for the LGBTQ+ community.
brand_dna.core_belief: If you can't buy it, start making it yourself - they built the Pride and nerdy clothing their own family couldn't find anywhere else.
proof_points: 100% queer run and family-owned business operating in Portland, Oregon
Crewneck tees now made in-house; other designs are NerdyKeppie original and exclusive
Made-to-order and print-on-demand so there is no waste
Real founder team named on the About page (Spider, Emet, Erykah) building the brand since 2016/2017
brand_dna.positioning: Community-first, values-driven independent maker - not a mass merch shop; every purchase supports a small queer family business and often a cause.

voice_pillars.name: By Us, For Us
voice_pillars.desc: Speaks as an insider to the LGBTQ+ and nerdy community, never as an outside observer marketing to them.

voice_pillars.name: Maker Roots
voice_pillars.desc: Grounded in the hands-on origin story of a family that made what they couldn't find.
voice_pillars.quote: If you can't buy it, start making it yourself!

voice_pillars.name: Inclusive and Practical
voice_pillars.desc: Prioritizes comfort, real body types, and useful details over hype.
voice_pillars.quote: comfortable, stylish options which fit a variety of expressions and body types

voice_pillars.name: Openly Activist
voice_pillars.desc: Names causes plainly and ties products to real-world support without softening the message.
voice_pillars.quote: Funds from this tee will be going directly into the Fish Outta Water Crew's upcoming transition costs.

phrases: The perfect shirt to march in a Pride parade in! Soft and comfy
So comfy and fits just right!
creative and fun merch, esoecually for gifts

icp: LGBTQ+ and allied nerds who want comfortable, expressive Pride and geeky merch and prefer to spend with a small queer-owned business whose values match their own.

personas.name: Stealth Activist
personas.description: Wants wearable identity and quiet resistance for daily life; moved by designs that let them signal values at work or in public.

personas.name: Gift-Giving Regular
personas.description: A repeat buyer stocking up for their queer friend group; moved by fun, giftable, batch-buyable items and community loyalty.

personas.name: Values-Match Shopper
personas.description: Buys specifically because the brand is queer and family-owned and gives back; moved by transparent origin and cause-tied products.
